author: Unreal Engine
description:
Mengyi Fan (Director of Viz at SHoP Architects) explains why the future of architecture isn't just about blueprints—it’s about storytelling. By blending gaming tech with real-world design, SHoP is creating interactive 3D spaces that prioritize the human experience.

If you’re a creator who loves tech AND humanity, this is your sign to look into ArchViz. 🛠️❤️

Watch the full interview for a look inside SHoP Architects!: https://youtu.be/NkvyTi3WUmk
title: The way we design our world is changing. 🏙️✨
